Subject: [dwm] Discworld Monthly - Extra - March 2008

            Discworld Monthly - Extra - March 2008

1. The Colour of Magic
2. The End
--------------------------------------------------------------------
1. The Colour of Magic ...

Since the premiere on Monday 3rd March (see April's newsletter for 
my view on the premiere and the production) various bits of 
information about The Colour of Magic adaptation (showing on SkyONE 
this Easter) are beginning to appear on various pages across the 
Internet.  The two part adaptation will be shown on Easter Sunday 
(23rd March) and Easter Monday (24th March) between 19:00 and 21:00 
(please remember to check your programme guide nearer the time!).

Needless to say the production values are top notch.  David Jason is 
brilliant as Rincewind, Twoflower is portrayed as the foreign 
tourist with style by Sean Astin and Tim Curry is excellent as 
Trymon the ever ambitious Wizard.  Not only are the performances 
excellent but the film is beautiful to watch.

One thing that The Mob and SkyOne tried (and for the most part 
succeeded) to keep secret before the premiere was the identity of 
the actor playing Vetinari.  As the information has now appeared in 
the UK daily papers I hope that it is OK for me to mention that 
Jeremy Irons plays the role perfectly.

It was announced at the premiere that the next Discworld adaptation 
that The Mob will tackle will be Going Postal.  I am very excited 
about this announcement and can't wait to see all the controversy 
about who is going to play Moist.  And no, for those with suspicious 
minds, this time round it will not be David Jason.

I have been sent a few promotional production photos and these can 
be found at my Picasaweb Gallery at: 
http://picasaweb.google.co.uk/dwm.oook/

Two of the social networking sites have had The Colour of Magic 
pages created.  Facebook has its The Colour of Magic page at: 
http://www.facebook.com/pages/The-Colour-Of-Magic/12756710265?ref=mf

It also gets an event page for the making of The Colour of Magic 
which will be shown on SkyONE on Sunday 16th March between 4:30pm 
and 5:30pm sign up if you will be viewing at: 
http://www.facebook.com/event.php?eid=8970633346&ref=share

MySpace gets a page that promises to offer exclusive photos and 
other material at: http://www.myspace.com/magiconskyone

And of course there is the official website (which is Flash heavy so 
watch out if you have a slow connection) that is beginning to be 
populated with Trailers, Computer Desktop Backgrounds, Photos from 
the production, a competition that will be coming soon, cast and 
crew biographies and much more.

See http://www.sky.com/magic for more details.

RHI the US backer of the adaptation have set up a site with over 180 
rather small pictures taken from the production of The Color [sic] 
of Magic at: 
http://www.rhifilms.com/property.php?propertyId=CofMagic&page=photos

Keep an eye on the Discworld Monthly website 
http://www.discworldmonthly.co.uk for more news and updates.
